entry.title: How to Export a PostgreSQL Database from a Docker Container (pg_dump Guide)
entry.summary:
If you're working with PostgreSQL inside Docker, sooner or later you'll need a backup. Maybe you're about to change something risky. The good news? It’s actually much simpler than it looks. In this guide, I’ll show you the easiest way to export your PostgreSQL database from a Docker container using pg_dump. docker exec -i postgres_container pg_dump -U postgres my_database > dump.sql
That’s it. Run this, and you’ll get a file called dump.sql on your machine containing your entire database. At first glance, this command looks a bit intimidating. But it’s actually doing something very logical. docker exec → “Run this command inside my container” -i → “Keep the connection open so data can stream out” postgres_container → Your Docker container name pg_dump → PostgreSQL’s built-in backup tool m…
